{{Recipe}}

'''Nigerian cocoyam chips''', popularly called kokoro in Yoruba, are a type of chips made with cocoyam (taro root).

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Taro Root|Cocoyam]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|Frying pan]]
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Stove|Stove]]

== Procedure ==

# Wash cocoyam with water, and peel the tuber. Rinse twice to remove dirt, then thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] it to your desired shape.
# Put the sliced cocoyam in a pot, then season with salt. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] well to season all of the cocoyam.
# Preheat the frying pan enough vegetable oil for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]. Add the cocoyam slices, working in batches if needed, and fry until crisp.
# Drain the cocoyam chips of excess oil, and serve.
